## The task

What are you trying to retrieve or preserve, and how often does it happen? Do not include private mail content.

## Current approach

Which MailCairn workflow or other tool have you tried? What works, and where do you get stuck?

## Desired outcome

Describe a successful result rather than only a proposed feature. Include a synthetic example if useful.

## Constraints

Relevant file formats, operating system, approximate archive size and requirements such as offline operation.
